title: User
description: User account + invite-code role. Also the `users` collection document, filling the gap flagged earlier — needed for invite-code roles, missing from §99's collection list. CAUTION: unlike Measurement/RiskAssessment/Decision, the architecture doc gives no worked example or dedicated section for this contract, so this is a heavier reconstruction than the other five locked contracts — built from the stakeholder categories in the problem statement and the invite-code role model referenced in your own notes. Diff this one especially carefully against the actual locked User.json.

role.description: Stakeholder categories from the problem statement, plus admin for invite-code issuance. Closed enum deliberately — role is access-control-relevant, unlike activity/vessel_type which are open config.

preferred_language.description: Default response_language override, applied when a request omits language_override. §7.8, §11

subscriber_id.description: Links to alert_subscriptions.subscriber_id, if this user has any alert subscriptions.
